newsitem.title: USA: Norwest Corp names Biller president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Norwest Corp names Biller president, COO.

text.p: Norwest Corp said Monday it has named Leslie Biller as president and chief operating officer of the company.

Biller replaces Richard Kovacevich as president. Kovacevich will remain as chairman and chief executive officer. The company said the position of chief operating officer has been vacant for several years.

Biller joined Norwest in August 1987, the company said, and most recently was responsible for community banking in Iowa and Nevada, Norwest Mortgage, Norwest Card Services, Norwest Direct, strategic development and community bank marketing.
As of December 31, 1996, Norwest had assets totaling $80.18 billion.
